concerns.text: SC‑004 requires the entire pipeline to complete in ≤ 30 minutes per run, but plan.md states an end‑to‑end limit of ≤ 6 hours, creating a direct contradiction that is not resolved in the task list.

Task T001 (quickstart documentation) is not linked to any functional requirement (FR‑*) or success criterion (SC‑*), leaving it as an orphan task that does not contribute to satisfying the specification.

The constitution (Principle III – Data Hygiene) mandates checksums for all raw and derived data files, yet no task records, updates, or validates checksums after download, featurisation, or fallback augmentation.
There is no task that measures or enforces the ≤ 30 minute runtime bound required by SC‑004, so the success criterion is effectively dropped.
